2010.text: Shopify has a relaxed, stress-free work environment so you can produce your best work here. We are a closely knit team and ready to help each other out at any time. We push to use the latest design and development techniques available. Learn more about working for Shopify .
2010.heading: What it’s like working for Shopify

2010.text: We want you to be able to produce your best work here at Shopify. You can wear whatever clothing you like, start work late in the morning, and play video games whenever you need a break. The office is also located in the trendy Ottawa market so there are lots of cool places to eat and play after work.
2010.heading: The Environment

2010.text: Everyone here rocks a 24" Apple LCD and peripherals to accompany their Macbook Pro. The office space is a mix of glass and exposed brick and upstairs you can even see the original chestnut beams circa 1870. There are no cubicles here, just open concept workspaces where we can all work together.

This is Shopify.
